title: Grateful Dead Live at Carrier Dome, Syracuse U on 1982-09-24
source: AUD (Beyer 88Âs) > MC > DAT > CDR via Raoul Duke encoded by Matt Vernon

ai_review.summary: Great audience recording captures the funky 1982 groove with a smoking Crazy Fingers sequence and an epic post‑drums jam.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers solid, bottom‑heavy sound that many reviewers call “great” for a dome audience source, letting listeners hear Jerry’s growling lead tone and the band’s tight funk rhythm. Musically the show is praised for its classic early‑80s set – standout versions of Jack Straw, Ramble On Rose, a powerful Playin’ > Crazy Fingers stretch, and an unforgettable after‑drums sequence culminating in Sugar Magnolia.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and sound quality indicate a strong show with good‑to‑excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the tape sounds great with pronounced bottom end, clear dome ambience and no major flaws; some prefer the audience mix over a soundboard version but overall find it one of the best dome recordings.

standout_songs: Playin' in the Band > Crazy Fingers
Iko Iko > Truckin' > Goin Down The Road Feeling Bad > Black Peter > Round and Round > Sugar Magnolia
show_quality.setlist_flow: Full, classic early‑80s first set with strong closers (LL Rain China > Rider) followed by a funk‑tinged second set that builds into an after‑drums jam, keeping the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar is described as growling seriously with a powerful tone, especially on the late‑show jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s stage antics during Sugar Magnolia (running around and jumping onto a speaker stack) are highlighted, adding visual excitement to the performance.
band_member_comments.Drums: The 1982 era drum groove is noted as funky and tight, with an impressive after‑drums sequence.
